  type AnnexIIISubcategory,
  type AISuggestion,
  type ProjectDetails,
  type ClassificationDetails,
  type ClassificationRequest,
} from "../../data/mockClassification";

interface ClassificationData extends ClassificationDetails {
  project: ProjectDetails;
  selectedCategory: string | null; // Helper: extraído de prjannexiiicategories
  selectedSubcategories: string[]; // Helper: extraído de prjannexiiicategories
  justification: string; // Helper: se almacenará en metadata o se añadirá como campo
  categories: AnnexIIICategory[];
}

export default function ClassificationPage() {
  const { t, language, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ClassificationData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [aiSuggestion, setAiSuggestion] = useState<AISuggestion | null>(null);
  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);
  const [classifying, setClassifying] = useState(false);
  const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));

      const projectIdParam = searchParams.get("projectId");
      if (projectIdParam) {
        const projectId = parseInt(projectIdParam, 10);
        const existingProject = mockClassifiedProjects.find((p) => p.id === projectId);

        if (existingProject) {
          const project: ProjectDetails = {
            ...mockProject,
            id: existingProject.id,
            name: existingProject.name,
            description: existingProject.description,
          };

          // Parsear prjannexiiicategories desde JSONB (simulado)
          const annexIIIData = parseAnnexIIICategories(
            createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(existingProject.category, existingProject.subcategories)
          );

          setData({
            project,
            prjishighrisk: true,
            prjannexiiicategories: createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(existingProject.category, existingProject.subcategories),
            prjclassificationdate: existingProject.classifiedDate,
            prjclassificationauthor: existingProject.classifiedBy,
            prjprohibitedusechecked: true,
            selectedCategory: annexIIIData.category || existingProject.category,
            selectedSubcategories: annexIIIData.subcategories || existingProject.subcategories,
            justification: existingProject.justification,
            categories: mockAnnexIIICategories,
            confidence: 0.95,
          });
          setSelectedCategory(existingProject.category);
          return;
        }
      }

      // Modo creación
      setData({
        project: mockProject,
        prjishighrisk: false,
        prjannexiiicategories: undefined,
        prjclassificationdate: undefined,
        prjclassificationauthor: undefined,
        prjprohibitedusechecked: false,
        prjregulatedsector: false,
        prjannexilegislation: undefined,
        selectedCategory: null,
        selectedSubcategories: [],
        justification: "",
        categories: mockAnnexIIICategories,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading classification data:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleSection = (section: string) => {
    setExpandedSections((prev) => ({ ...prev, [section]: !prev[section] }));
  };

  const handleCategorySelect = (categoryCode: string) => {
    setSelectedCategory(categoryCode);
    if (data) {
      const updatedSubcategories: string[] = [];
      const updatedAnnexIII = createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(categoryCode, updatedSubcategories);
      setData({
        ...data,
        selectedCategory: categoryCode,
        selectedSubcategories: updatedSubcategories,
        prjannexiiicategories: updatedAnnexIII,
      });
    }
    setValidationErrors([]);
  };

  const handleSubcategoryToggle = (subcategoryCode: string) => {
    if (!data) return;
    const current = data.selectedSubcategories || [];
    const updated = current.includes(subcategoryCode)
      ? current.filter((c) => c !== subcategoryCode)
      : [...current, subcategoryCode];

    // Actualizar prjannexiiicategories JSONB
    const category = data.selectedCategory || "";
    const updatedAnnexIII = createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(category, updated);

    setData({
      ...data,
      selectedSubcategories: updated,
      prjannexiiicategories: updatedAnnexIII,
    });
    setValidationErrors([]);
  };

  const validateJustificationQuality = (justification: string, categoryName: string): string[] => {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const justificationLower = justification.toLowerCase();
    const categoryNameLower = categoryName.toLowerCase();

    if (justification.length < 100) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.justificationMinLength", "La justificación debe tener al menos 100 caracteres"));
    }

    if (!justificationLower.includes(categoryNameLower)) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.justificationCategory", "La justificación debe mencionar la categoría seleccionada"));
    }

    const riskKeywords = ["riesgo", "alto riesgo", "vulnerable", "crítico", "risk", "high risk", "critical", "vulnerable"];
    const keywordCount = riskKeywords.filter((keyword) =>
      justificationLower.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())
    ).length;

    if (keywordCount < 2) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.justificationKeywords", "La justificación debe contener al menos 2 palabras clave de riesgo"));
    }

    return errors;
  };

  const validateClassification = (): boolean => {
    if (!data) return false;

    const errors: string[] = [];

    if (!data.prjprohibitedusechecked) {
      errors.push("Debe verificar que el sistema no está prohibido según el Art. 5 del EU AI Act");
    }

    if (!data.selectedCategory) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.categoryRequired", "Debe seleccionar una categoría principal"));
    }

    if ((data.selectedSubcategories || []).length === 0) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.subcategoryRequired", "Debe seleccionar al menos una subcategoría"));
    }

    if (data.selectedCategory) {
      const selectedCategoryData = data.categories.find((c) => c.anncategorycode === data.selectedCategory);
      if (selectedCategoryData) {
        const justificationErrors = validateJustificationQuality(
          data.justification || "",
          selectedCategoryData.anncategoryname
        );
        errors.push(...justificationErrors);
      }
    }

    setValidationErrors(errors);
    return errors.length === 0;
  };

  const handleAISuggest = async () => {
    if (!data) return;

    try {
      setAiLoading(true);
      setAiSuggestion(null);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

      const suggestion = mockAISuggestion;
      setAiSuggestion(suggestion);

      if (data) {
        setSelectedCategory(suggestion.suggestedCategory);
        const updatedAnnexIII = createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(
          suggestion.suggestedCategory,
          suggestion.suggestedSubcategories
        );
        setData({
          ...data,
          selectedCategory: suggestion.suggestedCategory,
          selectedSubcategories: suggestion.suggestedSubcategories,
          prjannexiiicategories: updatedAnnexIII,
          confidence: suggestion.confidence,
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error generating AI suggestion:", error);
    } finally {
      setAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClassify = async () => {
    if (!data || !validateClassification()) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      setClassifying(true);
      setSuccessMessage(null);
      setValidationErrors([]);

      // Crear ClassificationRequest según DTO
      const classificationRequest: ClassificationRequest = {
        projectId: data.project.id!,
        category: data.selectedCategory!,
        subcategories: data.selectedSubcategories,
        justification: data.justification || "",
        prohibitedUseChecked: data.prjprohibitedusechecked,
        prohibitedUseJustification: data.prjprohibitedusejustification,
        regulatedSector: data.prjregulatedsector,
        annexILegislation: data.prjannexilegislation ? JSON.parse(data.prjannexilegislation) : undefined,
      };

      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/classification/classify", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(classificationRequest),
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Classification failed");

      const result = await response.json();

      setSuccessMessage(t("governance.classification.classificationSuccess", "Proyecto clasificado exitosamente como alto riesgo"));

      if (result.workflowTriggered) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          alert(t("governance.classification.workflowTriggered", "Workflow BPMN activado para sistema de alto riesgo"));
        }, 500);
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/classification/projects";
      }, 1500);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error classifying project:", error);
      setValidationErrors([t("governance.classification.classificationError", "Error al clasificar el proyecto")]);
    } finally {
      setClassifying(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading || !data) {

      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const selectedCategoryData = data.categories.find((c) => c.anncategorycode === selectedCategory);
  const isHighRisk = data.prjishighrisk || data.selectedCategory !== null;
  const justificationLength = (data.justification || "").length;
  const minJustificationLength = 100;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80">

            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/classification/projects";
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              {t("common.back", "Volver")}
            </Button>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <Tag className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-500" />
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-yellow-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("governance.classification.title", "Clasificación de Sistemas de Alto Riesgo")}
                </h1>

                              {category.anncategorydescription}
                            </p>
                            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                              {category.subcategories?.length || 0} subcategorías
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          {selectedCategory === category.anncategorycode && (
                            <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-primary flex-shrink-0" />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </CardBody>
              </Card>

              {/* Card 2: Subcategorías */}
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <Tag className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    Subcategorías *
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardBody className="pt-0">
                  {selectedCategoryData ? (
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[calc(100vh-28rem)] overflow-y-auto">
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2 p-2 bg-accent/50 rounded">
                        {selectedCategoryData.anncategorydescription}
                      </p>
                      {selectedCategoryData.subcategories?.map((subcat) => (
                        <div
                          key={subcat.annsubcategorycode}
                          className={`flex items-start gap-2 p-2 border rounded transition-colors ${
                            (data.selectedSubcategories || []).includes(subcat.annsubcategorycode)
                              ? "border-primary bg-primary/5"
                              : "border-border hover:border-primary/50"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={(data.selectedSubcategories || []).includes(subcat.annsubcategorycode)}
                            onChange={() => handleSubcategoryToggle(subcat.annsubcategorycode)}
                            className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5"
                          />
                          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-0.5">
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs font-mono">
                                {subcat.annsubcategorycode}
                              </Badge>
                              <span className="font-medium text-xs truncate">{subcat.annsubcategoryname}</span>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{subcat.annsubcategorydescription}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="border rounded-lg p-6 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                      Selecciona una categoría
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardBody>
              </Card>

              {/* Card 3: Justificación */}
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    Justificación Técnica *
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardBody className="pt-0 space-y-2">
                  <Textarea
                    value={data.justification || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, justification: e.target.value })}
                    rows={12}
                    placeholder="Justificación detallada (mín. 100 caracteres). Debe mencionar la categoría y contener al menos 2 palabras clave de riesgo..."
                    className={`text-sm ${
                      justificationLength < minJustificationLength
                        ? "border-yellow-300 focus:border-yellow-500"
                        : ""
                    }`}
                  />
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      Mencionar categoría y 2+ palabras clave de riesgo
                    </p>
                    <div className={`text-xs font-medium ${
                      justificationLength < minJustificationLength
                        ? "text-yellow-600"
                        : "text-green-600"
                    }`}>
                      {justificationLength} / {minJustificationLength}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardBody>
              </Card>
            </div>
          </TabsContent>

          {/* Tab 3: Información Adicional */}
          <TabsContent value="additional" className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {/* Card 1: Modelos Asociados */}
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <Database className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    Modelos ({data.project.models.length})
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardBody className="pt-0 space-y-2 max-h-[calc(100vh-28rem)] overflow-y-auto">
                  {data.project.models.map((model) => (
                    <div key={model.id} className="border rounded-lg p-2 space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-xs">{model.name}</span>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">{model.version}</Badge>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">{model.type}</Badge>
                        </div>
                        {model.isGPAI && (
                          <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                            <Info className="h-2.5 w-2.5 mr-0.5" />
                            GPAI
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {model.isGPAI && (
                        <div className="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded p-2 space-y-1">
                          <div className="text-xs font-semibold">Modelo de Propósito General</div>
                          {model.flopsTraining && (
                            <div className="text-xs">
                              <strong>FLOPs:</strong> {model.flopsTraining.toLocaleString()}
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {model.systemicRisk && (
                            <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                              <AlertTriangle className="h-2.5 w-2.5 mr-0.5" />
                              Riesgo Sistémico
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </CardBody>
              </Card>

              {/* Card 2: Metadatos */}
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <FileCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    Metadatos
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardBody className="pt-0 space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">Confianza (%)</Label>
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      max="100"
                      value={data.confidence ? Math.round(data.confidence * 100) : ""}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setData({
                          ...data,
                          confidence: e.target.value ? parseFloat(e.target.value) / 100 : undefined,
                        })
                      }
                      placeholder="0-100"
                      className="mt-1 h-8 text-sm"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">Próxima Revisión</Label>
                    <Input
                      type="date"
                      value={data.nextReviewDate || ""}
                      onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, nextReviewDate: e.target.value })}
                      className="mt-1 h-8 text-sm"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">Responsable</Label>
                    <Input
                      value={data.complianceOfficer || ""}
                      onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, complianceOfficer: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="Nombre del responsable"
                      className="mt-1 h-8 text-sm"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">Notas Internas</Label>
                    <Textarea
                      value={data.internalNotes || ""}
                      onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, internalNotes: e.target.value })}
                      rows={4}
                      placeholder="Notas adicionales..."
                      className="mt-1 text-sm"
                    />
                  </div>
                  {data.workflowInstanceId && (
                    <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded p-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Info className="h-3 w-3 text-blue-600" />
                        <div className="text-xs">
                          <div className="font-semibold">Workflow BPMN</div>
                          <div className="text-muted-foreground">
                            {data.workflowInstanceId} | {data.workflowStatus || "Activo"}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardBody>
              </Card>

              {/* Card 3: Historial */}
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <History className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    Historial
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardBody className="pt-0">
                  {data.previousClassifications && data.previousClassifications.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[calc(100vh-28rem)] overflow-y-auto">
                      {data.previousClassifications.map((prev, index) => (
                        <div key={index} className="border rounded-lg p-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">{prev.category}</Badge>
                            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {new Date(prev.date).toLocaleDateString()}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Por: {prev.by}</p>
                          <p className="text-xs">{prev.reason}</p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="border rounded-lg p-6 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                      Sin historial
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardBody>
              </Card>
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import {
  Tag,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  FileText,
  Download,
  Sparkles,
  Loader2,
  Info,
  XCircle,
  ArrowLeft,
  Shield,
  Calendar,
  User,
  Building2,
  Database,
  FileCheck,
  History,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  ExternalLink,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import {
  mockAnnexIIICategories,
  mockProject,
  mockAISuggestion,
  mockClassifiedProjects,
  parseAnnexIIICategories,
  createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB,
  type AnnexIIICategory,
  type AnnexIIISubcategory,
  type AISuggestion,
  type ProjectDetails,
  type ClassificationDetails,
  type ClassificationRequest,
} from "../../data/mockClassification";

interface ClassificationData extends ClassificationDetails {
  project: ProjectDetails;
  selectedCategory: string | null; // Helper: extraído de prjannexiiicategories
  selectedSubcategories: string[]; // Helper: extraído de prjannexiiicategories
  justification: string; // Helper: se almacenará en metadata o se añadirá como campo
  categories: AnnexIIICategory[];
}

export default function ClassificationPage() {
  const { t, language, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ClassificationData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [aiSuggestion, setAiSuggestion] = useState<AISuggestion | null>(null);
  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);
  const [classifying, setClassifying] = useState(false);
  const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));

      const projectIdParam = searchParams.get("projectId");
      if (projectIdParam) {
        const projectId = parseInt(projectIdParam, 10);
        const existingProject = mockClassifiedProjects.find((p) => p.id === projectId);

        if (existingProject) {
          const project: ProjectDetails = {
            ...mockProject,
            id: existingProject.id,
            name: existingProject.name,
            description: existingProject.description,
          };

          // Parsear prjannexiiicategories desde JSONB (simulado)
          const annexIIIData = parseAnnexIIICategories(
            createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(existingProject.category, existingProject.subcategories)
          );

          setData({
            project,
            prjishighrisk: true,
            prjannexiiicategories: createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(existingProject.category, existingProject.subcategories),
            prjclassificationdate: existingProject.classifiedDate,
            prjclassificationauthor: existingProject.classifiedBy,
            prjprohibitedusechecked: true,
            selectedCategory: annexIIIData.category || existingProject.category,
            selectedSubcategories: annexIIIData.subcategories || existingProject.subcategories,
            justification: existingProject.justification,
            categories: mockAnnexIIICategories,
            confidence: 0.95,
          });
          setSelectedCategory(existingProject.category);
          return;
        }
      }

      // Modo creación
      setData({
        project: mockProject,
        prjishighrisk: false,
        prjannexiiicategories: undefined,
        prjclassificationdate: undefined,
        prjclassificationauthor: undefined,
        prjprohibitedusechecked: false,
        prjregulatedsector: false,
        prjannexilegislation: undefined,
        selectedCategory: null,
        selectedSubcategories: [],
        justification: "",
        categories: mockAnnexIIICategories,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading classification data:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCategorySelect = (categoryCode: string) => {
    setSelectedCategory(categoryCode);
    if (data) {
      const updatedSubcategories: string[] = [];
      const updatedAnnexIII = createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(categoryCode, updatedSubcategories);
      setData({
        ...data,
        selectedCategory: categoryCode,
        selectedSubcategories: updatedSubcategories,
        prjannexiiicategories: updatedAnnexIII,
      });
    }
    setValidationErrors([]);
  };

  const handleSubcategoryToggle = (subcategoryCode: string) => {
    if (!data) return;
    const current = data.selectedSubcategories || [];
    const updated = current.includes(subcategoryCode)
      ? current.filter((c) => c !== subcategoryCode)
      : [...current, subcategoryCode];

    // Actualizar prjannexiiicategories JSONB
    const category = data.selectedCategory || "";
    const updatedAnnexIII = createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(category, updated);

    setData({
      ...data,
      selectedSubcategories: updated,
      prjannexiiicategories: updatedAnnexIII,
    });
    setValidationErrors([]);
  };

  const validateJustificationQuality = (justification: string, categoryName: string): string[] => {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const justificationLower = justification.toLowerCase();
    const categoryNameLower = categoryName.toLowerCase();

    if (justification.length < 100) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.justificationMinLength", "La justificación debe tener al menos 100 caracteres"));
    }

    if (!justificationLower.includes(categoryNameLower)) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.justificationCategory", "La justificación debe mencionar la categoría seleccionada"));
    }

    const riskKeywords = ["riesgo", "alto riesgo", "vulnerable", "crítico", "risk", "high risk", "critical", "vulnerable"];
    const keywordCount = riskKeywords.filter((keyword) =>
      justificationLower.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())
    ).length;

    if (keywordCount < 2) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.justificationKeywords", "La justificación debe contener al menos 2 palabras clave de riesgo"));
    }

    return errors;
  };

  const validateClassification = (): boolean => {
    if (!data) return false;

    const errors: string[] = [];

    if (!data.prjprohibitedusechecked) {
      errors.push("Debe verificar que el sistema no está prohibido según el Art. 5 del EU AI Act");
    }

    if (!data.selectedCategory) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.categoryRequired", "Debe seleccionar una categoría principal"));
    }

    if ((data.selectedSubcategories || []).length === 0) {
      errors.push(t("governance.classification.subcategoryRequired", "Debe seleccionar al menos una subcategoría"));
    }

    if (data.selectedCategory) {
      const selectedCategoryData = data.categories.find((c) => c.anncategorycode === data.selectedCategory);
      if (selectedCategoryData) {
        const justificationErrors = validateJustificationQuality(
          data.justification || "",
          selectedCategoryData.anncategoryname
        );
        errors.push(...justificationErrors);
      }
    }

    setValidationErrors(errors);
    return errors.length === 0;
  };

  const handleAISuggest = async () => {
    if (!data) return;

    try {
      setAiLoading(true);
      setAiSuggestion(null);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

      const suggestion = mockAISuggestion;
      setAiSuggestion(suggestion);

      if (data) {
        setSelectedCategory(suggestion.suggestedCategory);
        const updatedAnnexIII = createAnnexIIICategoriesJSONB(
          suggestion.suggestedCategory,
          suggestion.suggestedSubcategories
        );
        setData({
          ...data,
          selectedCategory: suggestion.suggestedCategory,
          selectedSubcategories: suggestion.suggestedSubcategories,
          prjannexiiicategories: updatedAnnexIII,
          confidence: suggestion.confidence,
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error generating AI suggestion:", error);
    } finally {
      setAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClassify = async () => {
    if (!data || !validateClassification()) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      setClassifying(true);
      setSuccessMessage(null);
      setValidationErrors([]);

      // Crear ClassificationRequest según DTO
      const classificationRequest: ClassificationRequest = {
        projectId: data.project.id!,
        category: data.selectedCategory!,
        subcategories: data.selectedSubcategories,
        justification: data.justification || "",
        prohibitedUseChecked: data.prjprohibitedusechecked,
        prohibitedUseJustification: data.prjprohibitedusejustification,
        regulatedSector: data.prjregulatedsector,
        annexILegislation: data.prjannexilegislation ? JSON.parse(data.prjannexilegislation) : undefined,
      };

      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/classification/classify", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(classificationRequest),
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Classification failed");

      const result = await response.json();

      setSuccessMessage(t("governance.classification.classificationSuccess", "Proyecto clasificado exitosamente como alto riesgo"));

      if (result.workflowTriggered) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          alert(t("governance.classification.workflowTriggered", "Workflow BPMN activado para sistema de alto riesgo"));
        }, 500);
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/classification/projects";
      }, 1500);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error classifying project:", error);
      setValidationErrors([t("governance.classification.classificationError", "Error al clasificar el proyecto")]);
    } finally {
      setClassifying(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const selectedCategoryData = data.categories.find((c) => c.anncategorycode === selectedCategory);
  const isHighRisk = data.prjishighrisk || data.selectedCategory !== null;
  const justificationLength = (data.justification || "").length;
  const minJustificationLength = 100;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80">
      <div className="w-full px-4 py-3 space-y-3">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border rounded-lg p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/classification/projects";
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              {t("common.back", "Volver")}
            </Button>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <Tag className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-500" />
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-yellow-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("governance.classification.title", "Clasificación de Sistemas de Alto Riesgo")}
                </h1>
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {t("governance.classification.subtitle", "EU AI Act Art. 6 y Anexo III - Clasificación Completa")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleAISuggest} disabled={aiLoading}>
              {aiLoading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 mr-1 animate-spin" />
                  {t("governance.classification.aiSuggestionLoading", "Generando...")}
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                  {t("governance.classification.aiSuggestion", "Sugerencia IA")}
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
              <Download className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
              {t("governance.classification.exportPDF", "Exportar PDF")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/classification/projects";
              }}
            >
              {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleClassify} disabled={classifying} size="sm" className="bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90">
              {classifying ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FileText className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("governance.classification.classifyProject", "Clasificar Proyecto")}
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Mensajes */}
        {successMessage && (
          <Alert className="bg-green-50 border-green-200 mb-4">
            <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
            <AlertDescription className="text-green-800">{successMessage}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        {validationErrors.length > 0 && (
          <Alert variant="destructive" className="mb-4">
            <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {validationErrors.map((error, index) => (
                  <div key={index}>{error}</div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        {aiSuggestion && (
          <Alert className="bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 mb-4">
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
            <AlertDescription className="text-blue-800">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="font-semibold">
                  {t("governance.classification.aiSuggestionSuccess", "Sugerencia generada")} ({Math.round((aiSuggestion.confidence || 0) * 100)}%)
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm">{aiSuggestion.reasoning}</div>
              </div>
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        {/* Tabs para organizar contenido */}
        <Tabs defaultValue="general" className="w-full">
          <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3 mb-4">
            <TabsTrigger value="general" className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Building2 className="h-4 w-4" />
              General
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="classification" className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Tag className="h-4 w-4" />
              Clasificación
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="additional" className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Database className="h-4 w-4" />
              Adicional
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          {/* Tab 1: Información General */}
          <TabsContent value="general" className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {/* Card 1: Información del Proyecto */}
              <Card className="border-2">
                <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <Building2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    Información del Proyecto

}

Reorganización completada. Resumen de cambios:

## Pantallas reorganizadas con diseño compacto

### Pantalla de clasificación (`classification/page.tsx`)

1. Tabs para organizar el contenido:
   - Tab "General": Información del proyecto, propietario/cliente y validación Art. 5
   - Tab "Clasificación": Categorías, subcategorías y justificación
   - Tab "Adicional": Modelos, metadatos e historial

2. Cards horizontales (3 columnas, 33% cada una):
   - Cada tab muestra 3 cards lado a lado
   - Contenido visible sin expandir/colapsar
   - Altura máxima con scroll interno cuando es necesario

3. Diseño compacto:
   - Tamaños de fuente reducidos (`text-xs`, `text-sm`)
   - Padding reducido (`p-2`, `p-3`)
   - Inputs más pequeños (`h-8`)
   - Altura máxima calculada para evitar scroll de página

### Pantalla de listado (`projects/page.tsx`)

1. Estadísticas más compactas:
   - Cards con `p-3` en lugar de `p-4`
   - Texto más pequeño (`text-xl` en lugar de `text-2xl`)

2. Tabla más compacta:
   - Padding reducido (`px-3 py-2` en lugar de `px-4 py-3`)
   - Tamaños de fuente más pequeños
   - Altura máxima ajustada para mejor uso del espacio

3. Paginación compacta:
   - Botones más pequeños (`h-7` en lugar de `h-8`)
   - Texto más pequeño

### Correcciones adicionales

- Corregida función `getCategoryName` para usar `anncategorycode` y `anncategoryname`
- Eliminado código no utilizado (`expandedSections`, `toggleSection`)
- Todas las pantallas ocupan 100% de ancho

Las pantallas son más compactas, con menos scroll y mejor uso del espacio horizontal.

Revisando el prompt de negocio para identificar los endpoints del módulo de clasificación (excluyendo los de IA):

Según el prompt de clasificación, el módulo necesita 6 endpoints (excluyendo el de IA):

## Endpoints del módulo de clasificación (sin IA)

1. POST `/api/compliance/classification/classify`
   - Clasifica un proyecto como sistema de alto riesgo
   - Actualiza `PRJISHIGHRISK` y campos relacionados

2. GET `/api/compliance/classification/categories`
   - Obtiene el catálogo de categorías y subcategorías del Anexo III
   - Filtros: `expandSubcategories`, `categoryCode`, `activeOnly`

3. GET `/api/compliance/classification/projects`
   - Lista paginada de proyectos clasificados
   - Filtros: categoría, estado, búsqueda, fechas, usuario

4. GET `/api/compliance/classification/projects/{projectId}`
   - Detalles completos de un proyecto clasificado
   - Incluye modelos asociados y estado del workflow

5. PUT `/api/compliance/classification/projects/{projectId}`
   - Actualiza/reclasifica un proyecto existente
   - Mantiene historial si aplica

6. GET `/api/compliance/classification/projects/statistics`
   - Estadísticas agregadas (total, por categoría, por estado)
   - Filtros opcionales por rango de fechas

---

### Excluido (endpoint de IA):
- POST `/api/compliance/classification/suggest` — Genera sugerencia automática con IA

Total: 6 endpoints REST para el módulo de clasificación (sin IA).

El módulo de cumplimiento es extenso. Propongo una arquitectura modular con múltiples BFFs por subdominio:

## Propuesta: Arquitectura modular de BFFs para Compliance

### Análisis del alcance

Subdominios identificados:
1. Classification (Clasificación) — 6 endpoints
2. FRIA (Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment) — Art. 27
3. Conformity Assessment — Anexo VI, Art. 43
4. EU Registration — Art. 49
5. Prohibited Systems — Art. 5
6. Technical Documentation — Art. 11, Anexo IV
7. QMS (Quality Management System) — Art. 17
8. Immutable Logs — Art. 19
9. HITL (Human in the Loop)
10. PMM (Post-Market Monitoring)
11. Traceability

### Opción 1: Múltiples BFFs especializados (recomendado)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Frontend (Next.js)                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                          │
        ┌─────────────────┼─────────────────┐
        │                 │                 │
┌───────▼──────┐  ┌───────▼──────┐  ┌───────▼──────┐
│ BFF          │  │ BFF           │  │ BFF           │
│ Classification│  │ FRIA           │  │ Conformity    │
│              │  │                │  │ Assessment    │
│ 6 endpoints  │  │ ~8 endpoints   │  │ ~10 endpoints │
└───────┬──────┘  └───────┬──────┘  └───────┬──────┘
        │                 │                 │
        └─────────────────┼─────────────────┘
                          │
        ┌─────────────────┼─────────────────┐
        │                 │                 │
┌───────▼──────┐  ┌───────▼──────┐  ┌───────▼──────┐
│ Microservice │  │ Microservice  │  │ Microservice │
│ Classification│  │ FRIA          │  │ Conformity   │
└──────────────┘  └───────────────┘  └──────────────┘
```

Ventajas:
- Separación de responsabilidades
- Escalabilidad independiente
- Desarrollo y despliegue independientes
- Menor acoplamiento

Desventajas:
- Más servicios que gestionar
- Posible duplicación de código común

### Opción 2: BFF monolítico modular (alternativa)

Un solo BFF con módulos internos:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              BFF Compliance (Monolítico Modular)         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐ │
│  │ Module       │  │ Module       │  │ Module       │ │
│  │ Classification│  │ FRIA         │  │ Conformity   │ │
│  │              │  │              │  │              │ │
│  │ /api/        │  │ /api/        │  │ /api/        │ │
│  │ classification│  │ fria         │  │ conformity   │ │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘ │
│                                                         │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐ │
│  │ Module       │  │ Module       │  │ Module       │ │
│  │ EU Registration│ │ QMS          │  │ Logs         │ │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘ │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Ventajas:
- Un solo servicio que gestionar
- Código común compartido fácilmente
- Menos overhead operacional

Desventajas:
- Puede volverse complejo con el tiempo
- Escalado acoplado
- Riesgo de acoplamiento entre módulos

### Opción 3: Híbrida (recomendada para inicio)

Agrupar por frecuencia de uso y complejidad:

```
BFF 1: Core Compliance (Alto tráfico)
  - Classification (6 endpoints)
  - Conformity Assessment (~10 endpoints)
  - EU Registration (~5 endpoints)
  → ~21 endpoints

BFF 2: Assessment & Monitoring
  - FRIA (~8 endpoints)
  - PMM (~6 endpoints)
  - HITL (~4 endpoints)
  → ~18 endpoints

BFF 3: Governance & Quality
  - QMS (~8 endpoints)
  - Technical Docs (~6 endpoints)
  - Immutable Logs (~5 endpoints)
  - Prohibited Systems (~4 endpoints)
  → ~23 endpoints
```

### Recomendación

Empezar con la Opción 3 (híbrida) y evolucionar hacia la Opción 1 si crece la complejidad.

Estructura propuesta:

```
codeflowx-govern-bff-compliance-core/
  ├── classification/

#### 2. Base Controller para Partners

```java
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/compliance/{module}")
@Validated
public abstract class BaseComplianceController<T extends BaseRequest, R extends BaseResponse> {
    
    @Autowired
    protected ComplianceServiceInterface<T, R> service;
    
    @PostMapping("/{action}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('admin', 'compliance_officer')")
    public ResponseEntity<StandardResponse<R>> execute(
        @PathVariable String module,
        @PathVariable String action,
        @Valid @RequestBody T request,
        Authentication auth
    ) {
        // Framework maneja:
        // - Validación estándar
        // - Autenticación/autorización
        // - Logging
        // - Error handling
        // - Response wrapping
        
        R response = service.process(request, auth);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(StandardResponse.success(response));
    }
    
    // Métodos helper para partners
    protected void validateProject(Long projectId) { ... }
    protected void triggerWorkflow(String workflowKey, Map<String, Object> vars) { ... }
    protected void logAction(String action, Long projectId) { ... }
}
```

#### 3. Implementación por Partner (ejemplo: Classification)

```java
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/compliance/classification")
public class ClassificationController extends BaseComplianceController<
    ClassificationRequest, 
    ClassificationResponse
> {
    
    @PostMapping("/classify")
    public ResponseEntity<StandardResponse<ClassificationResponse>> classify(
        @Valid @RequestBody ClassificationRequest request,
        Authentication auth
    ) {
        // Partner solo implementa lógica específica
        ClassificationResponse response = classificationService.classify(
            request.getProjectId(),
            request.getCategory(),
            request.getSubcategories(),
            request.getJustification()
        );
        
        return ResponseEntity.ok(StandardResponse.success(response));
    }
    
    // Otros endpoints específicos...
}
```

### Ventajas de este enfoque

1. Para partners:
   - Extienden clases base del framework
   - Implementan solo lógica de negocio
   - Framework maneja infraestructura común

2. Para el equipo core:
   - Control de estándares (seguridad, logging, errores)
   - Actualizaciones centralizadas del framework
   - Documentación única

3. Escalabilidad:
   - Cada partner mantiene su módulo
   - Framework evoluciona independientemente
   - Fácil añadir nuevos módulos

### Estructura de módulos recomendada

```
Partner A: Classification Module
├── ClassificationController (extiende BaseComplianceController)
├── ClassificationService (implementa ComplianceServiceInterface)
├── ClassificationRequest/Response (extienden BaseRequest/Response)
└── ClassificationValidator (usa StandardValidators)

Partner B: FRIA Module
├── FriaController
├── FriaService
└── FriaRequest/Response

Partner C: Conformity Module
├── ConformityController
├── ConformityService
└── ConformityRequest/Response
```

### Documentación necesaria para Partners

1. Guía de inicio rápido
2. API Reference del Framework
3. Ejemplos de implementación
4. Guía de testing
5. Guía de despliegue

### 1. Componentes base extensibles

#### BaseClassificationForm (componente base)

```typescript
// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/components/compliance/BaseClassificationForm.tsx

import { useComplianceForm } from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk/hooks';
import { ComplianceTabs } from './ComplianceTabs';
import { ProjectInfoCard } from './ProjectInfoCard';
import { ExtensionSlot } from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk/extensions';

interface BaseClassificationFormProps {
  projectId: number;
  onSave?: (data: ClassificationData) => void;
  extensions?: {
    beforeForm?: React.ComponentType;
    afterForm?: React.ComponentType;
    customTabs?: TabConfig[];
  };
}

export function BaseClassificationForm({ 
  projectId, 
  onSave,
  extensions 
}: BaseClassificationFormProps) {
  const { data, loading, save, validate } = useComplianceForm(projectId);
  
  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      {/* Slot para extensiones antes del formulario */}
      <ExtensionSlot name="classification.beforeForm" />
      
      <ComplianceTabs
        defaultTab="general"
        customTabs={extensions?.customTabs}
      >
        <TabsContent value="general">
          <ProjectInfoCard project={data.project} />
          {/* Slot para extensiones en tab general */}
          <ExtensionSlot name="classification.general.afterProject" />
        </TabsContent>
        
        <TabsContent value="classification">
          {/* Contenido base de clasificación */}
          <ExtensionSlot name="classification.classification.before" />
          {/* Componentes base */}
          <ExtensionSlot name="classification.classification.after" />
        </TabsContent>
        
        {/* Tabs personalizados de partners */}
        {extensions?.customTabs?.map(tab => (
          <TabsContent key={tab.id} value={tab.id}>
            {tab.content}
          </TabsContent>
        ))}
      </ComplianceTabs>
      
      {/* Slot para extensiones después del formulario */}
      <ExtensionSlot name="classification.afterForm" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### 2. Sistema de slots para extensiones

```typescript
// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/extensions/SlotSystem.tsx

interface ExtensionSlotProps {
  name: string;
  fallback?: React.ReactNode;
  props?: Record<string, any>;
}

export function ExtensionSlot({ name, fallback, props }: ExtensionSlotProps) {
  const extensions = useExtensionRegistry();
  const slotExtensions = extensions.getSlot(name);
  
  if (slotExtensions.length === 0) {
    return fallback || null;
  }
  
  return (
    <>
      {slotExtensions.map((Extension, index) => (
        <Extension key={index} {...props} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

// Uso por partners:
// En su código:
registerExtension('classification.general.afterProject', () => (
  <CustomRiskAssessmentCard projectId={projectId} />
));
```

### 3. Hooks compartidos

```typescript
// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/hooks/useComplianceForm.ts

export function useComplianceForm(projectId: number) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<ClassificationData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const { validateClassification } = useComplianceValidation();
  const { saveClassification } = useComplianceAPI();
  
  const loadData = async () => {
    // Lógica base de carga
  };
  
  const save = async (formData: Partial<ClassificationData>) => {
    // Validación base
    const errors = validateClassification(formData);
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      throw new ValidationError(errors);
    }
    
    // Guardar
    const result = await saveClassification(projectId, formData);
    
    // Hooks para extensiones
    emitEvent('classification.saved', { projectId, result });
    
    return result;
  };
  
  return {
    data,
    loading,
    save,
    validate: validateClassification,
    loadData
  };
}
```

### 4. Ejemplo de extensión por partner

```typescript
// Partner: Extensión de pantalla de clasificación

import { 
  BaseClassificationForm,
  registerExtension,
  useComplianceForm,
  ExtensionSlot 
} from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk';

// 1. Registrar componente en slot existente
registerExtension('classification.general.afterProject', ({ projectId }) => {

// 2. Añadir nuevo tab personalizado

];

// 3. Extender la pantalla base

      projectId={projectId}
      extensions={{
        customTabs,
        beforeForm: () => <CustomBanner />,
        afterForm: () => <CustomFooter />
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

### 5. Sistema de plugins/extensiones

```typescript
// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/extensions/ExtensionRegistry.ts

class ExtensionRegistry {
  private extensions = new Map<string, React.ComponentType[]>();
  private hooks = new Map<string, Function[]>();
  
  registerSlot(name: string, component: React.ComponentType) {
    const existing = this.extensions.get(name) || [];
    this.extensions.set(name, [...existing, component]);
  }
  
  registerHook(event: string, handler: Function) {
    const existing = this.hooks.get(event) || [];
    this.hooks.set(event, [...existing, handler]);
  }
  
  getSlot(name: string): React.ComponentType[] {
    return this.extensions.get(name) || [];
  }
  
  emit(event: string, data: any) {
    const handlers = this.hooks.get(event) || [];
    handlers.forEach(handler => handler(data));
  }
}

export const extensionRegistry = new ExtensionRegistry();
```

### 7. Configuración de extensión

```typescript
// partner-compliance-extensions/registration.ts

import { registerExtension } from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk';
import { RiskMatrixExtension } from './classification/extensions/RiskMatrixExtension';
import { CustomFriaFields } from './fria/extensions/CustomFriaFields';

// Registrar extensiones al cargar el módulo
export function registerComplianceExtensions() {
  // Extender pantalla de clasificación
  registerExtension(
    'classification.general.afterProject',
    RiskMatrixExtension
  );
  
  // Extender pantalla FRIA
  registerExtension(
    'fria.form.customFields',
    CustomFriaFields
  );
  
  // Registrar hooks
  registerHook('classification.saved', (data) => {
    // Lógica personalizada después de guardar
    console.log('Classification saved:', data);
  });
}
```

### 8. Documentación para partners

```markdown
# Guía de Extensión - Compliance SDK

## Extender una pantalla existente

```typescript
import { BaseClassificationForm, registerExtension } from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk';

// Añadir componente en slot
registerExtension('classification.general.afterProject', ({ projectId }) => {
  return <YourCustomComponent projectId={projectId} />;
});
```

## Crear nueva funcionalidad

```typescript
import { useComplianceForm, useComplianceAPI } from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk';

export function YourCustomFeature({ projectId }) {
  const { data, save } = useComplianceForm(projectId);
  const { customAPI } = useComplianceAPI();
  
  // Tu lógica personalizada
}
```

## Slots disponibles

- `classification.beforeForm`
- `classification.afterForm`
- `classification.general.afterProject`
- `classification.classification.before`
- `fria.form.customFields`
- ...
```

### Ventajas

1. Para partners:
   - Extienden sin modificar código base
   - Reutilizan componentes y hooks
   - Mantienen compatibilidad con actualizaciones

2. Para el equipo core:
   - Control de la estructura base
   - Actualizaciones sin romper extensiones
   - Documentación centralizada

3. Escalabilidad:
   - Múltiples partners pueden extender simultáneamente
   - Extensiones aisladas
   - Fácil testing

// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/components/compliance/BaseClassificationForm.tsx

import { useComplianceForm } from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk/hooks';
import { ComplianceTabs } from './ComplianceTabs';
import { ProjectInfoCard } from './ProjectInfoCard';
import { ExtensionSlot } from '@codeflowx/compliance-sdk/extensions';

interface BaseClassificationFormProps {
  projectId: number;
  onSave?: (data: ClassificationData) => void;
  extensions?: {
    beforeForm?: React.ComponentType;
    afterForm?: React.ComponentType;
    customTabs?: TabConfig[];
  };
}

export function BaseClassificationForm({ 
  projectId, 
  onSave,
  extensions 
}: BaseClassificationFormProps) {
  const { data, loading, save, validate } = useComplianceForm(projectId);
  
  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      {/* Slot para extensiones antes del formulario */}
      <ExtensionSlot name="classification.beforeForm" />
      
      <ComplianceTabs
        defaultTab="general"
        customTabs={extensions?.customTabs}
      >
        <TabsContent value="general">
          <ProjectInfoCard project={data.project} />
          {/* Slot para extensiones en tab general */}
          <ExtensionSlot name="classification.general.afterProject" />
        </TabsContent>
        
        <TabsContent value="classification">
          {/* Contenido base de clasificación */}
          <ExtensionSlot name="classification.classification.before" />
          {/* Componentes base */}
          <ExtensionSlot name="classification.classification.after" />
        </TabsContent>
        
        {/* Tabs personalizados de partners */}
        {extensions?.customTabs?.map(tab => (
          <TabsContent key={tab.id} value={tab.id}>
            {tab.content}
          </TabsContent>
        ))}
      </ComplianceTabs>
      
      {/* Slot para extensiones después del formulario */}
      <ExtensionSlot name="classification.afterForm" />
    </div>
  );
}

```typescript
// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/extensions/SlotSystem.tsx

interface ExtensionSlotProps {
  name: string;
  fallback?: React.ReactNode;
  props?: Record<string, any>;
}

export function ExtensionSlot({ name, fallback, props }: ExtensionSlotProps) {
  const extensions = useExtensionRegistry();
  const slotExtensions = extensions.getSlot(name);
  
  if (slotExtensions.length === 0) {
    return fallback || null;
  }
  
  return (
    <>
      {slotExtensions.map((Extension, index) => (
        <Extension key={index} {...props} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

// Uso por partners:
// En su código:
registerExtension('classification.general.afterProject', () => (
  <CustomRiskAssessmentCard projectId={projectId} />
));

// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/hooks/useComplianceForm.ts

export function useComplianceForm(projectId: number) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<ClassificationData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const { validateClassification } = useComplianceValidation();
  const { saveClassification } = useComplianceAPI();
  
  const loadData = async () => {
    // Lógica base de carga
  };
  
  const save = async (formData: Partial<ClassificationData>) => {
    // Validación base
    const errors = validateClassification(formData);
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      throw new ValidationError(errors);
    }
    
    // Guardar
    const result = await saveClassification(projectId, formData);
    
    // Hooks para extensiones
    emitEvent('classification.saved', { projectId, result });
    
    return result;
  };
  
  return {
    data,
    loading,
    save,
    validate: validateClassification,
    loadData
  };
}

```typescript
// @codeflowx/compliance-sdk/extensions/ExtensionRegistry.ts

class ExtensionRegistry {
  private extensions = new Map<string, React.ComponentType[]>();
  private hooks = new Map<string, Function[]>();
  
  registerSlot(name: string, component: React.ComponentType) {
    const existing = this.extensions.get(name) || [];
    this.extensions.set(name, [...existing, component]);
  }
  
  registerHook(event: string, handler: Function) {
    const existing = this.hooks.get(event) || [];
    this.hooks.set(event, [...existing, handler]);
  }
  
  getSlot(name: string): React.ComponentType[] {
    return this.extensions.get(name) || [];
  }
  
  emit(event: string, data: any) {
    const handlers = this.hooks.get(event) || [];
    handlers.forEach(handler => handler(data));
  }
}

export const extensionRegistry = new ExtensionRegistry();

2. Organización clara por módulos

5. Sin complejidad de SDKs ni extensiones

package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance;

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.OpenAPIDefinition;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.info.Contact;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.info.Info;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties;

/**
 * Backend for Frontend (BFF) reactivo para el módulo de Compliance.
 * 
 * Este BFF actúa como capa de agregación entre el frontend y los microservicios de negocio,
 * proporcionando endpoints optimizados para las necesidades del frontend con:
 * - Programación reactiva (WebFlux)
 * - Resiliencia (Circuit Breaker, Retry, Rate Limiting)
 * - Agregación de datos de múltiples microservicios
 */
@SpringBootApplication(scanBasePackages = "com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance")
@OpenAPIDefinition(
        info = @Info(
                title = "CodeflowX Compliance BFF",
                version = "1.0",
                description = "Backend for Frontend reactivo para módulo de Compliance. " +
                             "Agrega datos de múltiples microservicios y proporciona endpoints optimizados para el frontend.",
                contact = @Contact(name = "CodeflowX", email = "governance@codeflowx.ai")
        ),
        tags = {
                @Tag(name = "FRIA", description = "Evaluaciones de Impacto en Derechos Fundamentales (Art. 27)"),
                @Tag(name = "Classification", description = "Clasificación de sistemas de alto riesgo (Art. 6 + Anexo III)"),
                @Tag(name = "Conformity", description = "Evaluaciones de conformidad (Anexo VI, Art. 43)"),
                @Tag(name = "EU Registration", description = "Registro en Base de Datos UE (Art. 49)")
        }
)
public class ComplianceBffApplication {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SpringApplication.run(ComplianceBffApplication.class, args);
    }
}

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.dto.fria.FriaAssessmentRequest;
import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.dto.fria.FriaAssessmentResponse;
import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.service.FriaService;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Controller reactivo para evaluaciones FRIA (Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment).
 * 
 * Este controller actúa como BFF, agregando datos de múltiples microservicios
 * y proporcionando endpoints optimizados para el frontend.
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/compliance/fria/assessments - Iniciar evaluación FRIA
 * - GET /api/compliance/fria/assessments/{id} - Obtener evaluación FRIA
 * - PUT /api/compliance/fria/assessments/{id} - Actualizar evaluación FRIA
 * - GET /api/compliance/fria/assessments - Listar evaluaciones FRIA
 * - POST /api/compliance/fria/assessments/{id}/calculate-risk - Calcular riesgo final
 * - GET /api/compliance/fria/assessments/{id}/status - Obtener estado de evaluación
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/compliance/fria")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Tag(name = "FRIA", description = "Evaluaciones de Impacto en Derechos Fundamentales (Art. 27 EU AI Act)")
public class FriaController {

    private final FriaService friaService;

    @PostMapping("/assessments")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Iniciar evaluación FRIA",
            description = "Inicia una nueva evaluación FRIA (Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment) para un proyecto. " +
                         "Este endpoint agrega datos de múltiples microservicios y dispara el workflow BPMN correspondiente."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "201",
                    description = "Evaluación FRIA iniciada exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = FriaAssessmentResponse.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o datos faltantes"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Proyecto no encontrado"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<FriaAssessmentResponse>> createAssessment(
            @Valid @RequestBody FriaAssessmentRequest request) {
        
        log.info("Iniciando evaluación FRIA: projectId={}, triggerReason={}",
                request.getProjectId(), request.getTriggerReason());

        return friaService.createAssessment(request)
                .map(assessment -> {
                    log.info("Evaluación FRIA creada: assessmentId={}, projectId={}",
                            assessment.getId(), request.getProjectId());
                    return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(assessment);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error creando evaluación FRIA para projectId={}", 
                            request.getProjectId(), error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/assessments/{id}")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener evaluación FRIA",
            description = "Obtiene los detalles completos de una evaluación FRIA, agregando datos de " +
                         "múltiples microservicios (proyecto, modelos, workflow, etc.)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Evaluación FRIA encontrada",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = FriaAssessmentResponse.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación FRIA no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<FriaAssessmentResponse>> getAssessment(@PathVariable Long id) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo evaluación FRIA: id={}", id);
        
        return friaService.getAssessment(id)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .defaultIfEmpty(ResponseEntity.notFound().build())
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error obteniendo evaluación FRIA: id={}", id, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PutMapping("/assessments/{id}")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Actualizar evaluación FRIA",
            description = "Actualiza una evaluación FRIA existente. Solo permite actualizar ciertos campos " +
                         "según el estado actual de la evaluación."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Evaluación FRIA actualizada",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = FriaAssessmentResponse.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o estado no permitido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación FRIA no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<FriaAssessmentResponse>> updateAssessment(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @Valid @RequestBody FriaAssessmentRequest request) {
        
        log.info("Actualizando evaluación FRIA: id={}", id);
        
        return friaService.updateAssessment(id, request)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .defaultIfEmpty(ResponseEntity.notFound().build())
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error actualizando evaluación FRIA: id={}", id, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/assessments")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Listar evaluaciones FRIA",
            description = "Obtiene una lista paginada de evaluaciones FRIA con filtros opcionales."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Lista de evaluaciones FRIA"
            )
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Object>> listAssessments(
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long projectId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") int size) {
        
        log.debug("Listando evaluaciones FRIA: projectId={}, status={}, page={}, size={}",
                projectId, status, page, size);
        
        return friaService.listAssessments(projectId, status, page, size)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error listando evaluaciones FRIA", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/assessments/{id}/calculate-risk")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Calcular riesgo final",
            description = "Calcula el riesgo final de una evaluación FRIA según el Anexo IX del EU AI Act."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Riesgo calculado exitosamente"
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación FRIA no encontrada"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Evaluación incompleta para calcular riesgo")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<FriaAssessmentResponse>> calculateRisk(@PathVariable Long id) {
        log.info("Calculando riesgo final para evaluación FRIA: id={}", id);
        
        return friaService.calculateFinalRisk(id)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .defaultIfEmpty(ResponseEntity.notFound().build())
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error calculando riesgo para evaluación FRIA: id={}", id, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/assessments/{id}/status")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener estado de evaluación",
            description = "Obtiene el estado actual de una evaluación FRIA y el progreso del workflow BPMN asociado."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Estado de evaluación obtenido"
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación FRIA no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Object>> getAssessmentStatus(@PathVariable Long id) {
        log.debug("Obteniendo estado de evaluación FRIA: id={}", id);
        
        return friaService.getAssessmentStatus(id)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .defaultIfEmpty(ResponseEntity.notFound().build())
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error obteniendo estado de evaluación FRIA: id={}", id, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }
}

package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.service;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.dto.fria.FriaAssessmentRequest;
import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.dto.fria.FriaAssessmentResponse;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Servicio reactivo para evaluaciones FRIA.
 * 
 * Este servicio actúa como agregador, llamando a múltiples microservicios de negocio
 * y combinando sus respuestas para el frontend.
 */
public interface FriaService {
    
    /**
     * Crea una nueva evaluación FRIA.
     * Agrega datos de: Project Service, BPMN Service
     */
    Mono<FriaAssessmentResponse> createAssessment(FriaAssessmentRequest request);
    
    /**
     * Obtiene una evaluación FRIA con todos sus datos agregados.
     * Agrega datos de: Project Service, BPMN Service, FRIA Business Service
     */
    Mono<FriaAssessmentResponse> getAssessment(Long id);
    
    /**
     * Actualiza una evaluación FRIA existente.
     */
    Mono<FriaAssessmentResponse> updateAssessment(Long id, FriaAssessmentRequest request);
    
    /**
     * Lista evaluaciones FRIA con paginación y filtros.
     */
    Mono<Object> listAssessments(Long projectId, String status, int page, int size);
    
    /**
     * Calcula el riesgo final según Anexo IX.
     * Llama a: FRIA Business Service
     */
    Mono<FriaAssessmentResponse> calculateFinalRisk(Long id);
    
    /**
     * Obtiene el estado de una evaluación y su workflow.
     * Agrega datos de: BPMN Service
     */
    Mono<Object> getAssessmentStatus(Long id);
}

server:
  port: 8083

spring:
  application:
    name: compliance-bff
  
  # Configuración para llamadas a microservicios
  cloud:
    loadbalancer:
      enabled: true

# Resilience4j Configuration
resilience4j:
  circuitbreaker:
    instances:
      projectService:
        registerHealthIndicator: true
        slidingWindowSize: 10
        minimumNumberOfCalls: 5
        permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState: 3
        automaticTransitionFromOpenToHalfOpenEnabled: true
        waitDurationInOpenState: 10s
        failureRateThreshold: 50
        eventConsumerBufferSize: 10
      bpmnService:
        registerHealthIndicator: true
        slidingWindowSize: 10
        minimumNumberOfCalls: 5
        permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState: 3
        automaticTransitionFromOpenToHalfOpenEnabled: true
        waitDurationInOpenState: 10s
        failureRateThreshold: 50
      friaBusinessService:
        registerHealthIndicator: true
        slidingWindowSize: 10
        minimumNumberOfCalls: 5
        permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState: 3
        automaticTransitionFromOpenToHalfOpenEnabled: true
        waitDurationInOpenState: 10s
        failureRateThreshold: 50
  
  retry:
    instances:
      projectService:
        maxAttempts: 3
        waitDuration: 1s
        retryExceptions:
          - java.net.ConnectException
          - java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException
        ignoreExceptions:
          - com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.exception.NotFoundException
      bpmnService:
        maxAttempts: 3
        waitDuration: 1s
        retryExceptions:
          - java.net.ConnectException
          - java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException

# Actuator
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,info,metrics,circuitbreakers,circuitbreakerevents
  endpoint:
    health:
      show-details: when-authorized
  metrics:
    export:
      prometheus:
        enabled: true

# OpenAPI/Swagger
springdoc:
  api-docs:
    path: /api-docs
  swagger-ui:
    path: /swagger-ui.html
    enabled: true

# Logging
logging:
  level:
    com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance: INFO
    org.springframework.web: DEBUG
    io.github.resilience4j: DEBUG
